loginGuard.title: Login protection
loginGuard.scopeHint: Saving writes the thresholds to the database and applies them immediately, no restart needed. Principals that are already locked stay locked until the window expires or you unlock them here.
loginGuard.thresholdDesc: All four thresholds are submitted together and take effect as soon as they are saved — no restart needed.
loginGuard.principalFailuresHint: Default 5. Reaching it locks that account for this IP.
loginGuard.perIpFailuresHint: Default 30. Stops an attacker from switching usernames; behind NAT or a shared office network, failures from several accounts add up here.
loginGuard.windowMinutesHint: Failures older than the window are forgotten. 0 means failures are not counted at all.
loginGuard.lockMinutesHint: How long a principal stays locked. 0 means record only, never lock.
loginGuard.invalidThreshold: A threshold is out of range
loginGuard.saveSuccess: Login protection settings saved and applied
loginGuard.lockedDesc: Unlocking applies immediately; there is nothing to save.
loginGuard.unlockAllConfirm: Unlock everything? This clears every failure counter on this instance only.
loginGuard.noLocked: No account or IP is locked right now
loginGuard.instanceOnlyHint: Failure counters live in each instance's memory: unlocking here only affects this instance. With several replicas the other copies keep their counters, so unlock each one.
loginGuard.loadFailed: Failed to load login protection settings
